steps.title: Cervical cord impingement · causes

pins.name: Disc pathology
pins.text: Inflammation, degeneration or herniation.

pins.name: Other causes
pins.text: Neck trauma; tumors, infections and congenital vertebral anomalies.

steps.caption: Select a colored number to isolate its structure. Rotate to inspect the same anatomy from another angle.

steps.title: Effects depend on the level

pins.name: Respiratory / sensory
pins.text: Respiratory dysfunction; neck and limb pain or numbness.

pins.name: Motor
pins.text: Neck, upper/lower limb stiffness, weakness or paralysis.

pins.name: Visceral
pins.text: Urination, defecation, erection and ejaculation dysfunction.

steps.caption: Select a colored number to isolate its structure. Rotate to inspect the same anatomy from another angle.

steps.title: Disc pathology or bone spurs → nerve encroachment

pins.name: Causes
pins.text: Disc herniation, disc degeneration or bone spurs.

pins.name: Effects
pins.text: Numbness, local or radiating pain, and weakness depend on nerve involved.

steps.caption: Select a colored number to isolate its structure. Rotate to inspect the same anatomy from another angle.

pins.name: L1 → L5
pins.text: Lumbar IVF become narrower; spinal nerves become larger.

pins.name: Lower-level risk
pins.text: Greater chance of nerve encroachment due to foraminal stenosis.

steps.title: Four sensory modalities · compare both sides

pins.name: Position sense
pins.text: Start at distal interphalangeal joint; move distal phalanx randomly up/down. Eyes closed; test and compare both sides.
